message.content:
Fix 64 element-level spacing/sizing bugs on Boldteq homepage in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

CONTEXT: Element-level Playwright diff vs `https://boldteq.com` shows badges, buttons, padding, grids drift. Full report at `tests/screenshots/spacing-diff.json`. User feedback: "UI spacing not polished, not consistent, not same as Webflow." Production-grade fix needed.

EXACT FIXES (Webflow values verbatim — no compensation hacks):

1. **Trustpilot badge** (`/images/webflow/Group-46731.svg` in src/components/home/hero.tsx):
   - Current: width=200 height=36 → renders 200×30
   - Live: 248×34
   - Fix: change `<Image width={248} height={34}>` for the trustpilot badge

2. **CTA primary button `.a-gulf-book` mobile** — height local 56px vs live 52px:
   - In `src/components/home/hero.module.css` at @max-width:479, find `.a-gulf-book` rule. Adjust `padding`/`line-height` to bring height to 52px. Likely `padding: 0.625rem 3rem 0.625rem 1.25rem` (was 0.75rem) OR `font-size: 1rem` (was 1.1rem).

3. **CTA secondary button `.a-except-get`** — same as #2 — make height 52px.

4. **Navbar "Join Beta" link** (`#bt-popup-trigger.beta-link` in src/components/layout/navbar.tsx):
   - Current: padding `2px 10px` + border-radius `6px` + bg `rgb(14,45,84)` + color cyan
   - Live: padding `0` + radius `0` + bg transparent + color WHITE
   - Fix in src/components/layout/navbar.module.css `.beta-link`: remove padding/bg/radius, set color: `#fff`. Just plain underlined or styled text link.

5. **Built-for card border** (`.built-grid-outer-new` in src/components/home/built-for.module.css):
   - Current: `border: 1px solid #e7e7e7`
   - Live: `border: 0` (no visible border, just bg image)
   - Fix: remove border or set to `border: 0`

6. **Built-for section padding** (`.built-seccc`):
   - Desktop+991 local has `padding-bottom: 38px` (compensation hack from earlier)
   - Live: `padding-bottom: 0`
   - Mobile 375 local `padding-bottom: 80px`, live `60px`
   - Fix: REMOVE the compensation. Use Webflow exact values: 1440/991: `padding: 60px 5% 0`, 767: `padding: 60px 5% 0`, 479: `padding: 0 5% 60px`

7. **Built-for grid columns at 768** (`.built-3-grid-new`):
   - Local: 4-column grid renders as 4 narrow cards
   - Live: 2-column grid (335 px wide cards)
   - Fix: at @max-width:991 (which catches 768), set `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` to match Webflow's 2-col tablet layout

8. **Built-for grid gap at 768**: live 20px, local 16px. Fix gap to 20px at 991.

9. **Resolution section padding** (`.blue-card-sec` in resolution-banner.module.css):
   - Local @min-width:1280/1440: `padding-top: 26px` (compensation)
   - Live: `padding: 0 5%` (no top/bottom)
   - Fix: REMOVE the 26px top compensation. Set `padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0` at desktop.

10. **Heading-2 pricing margin-bottom** (`.heading2` in pricing-section.module.css):
    - Local: `margin-bottom: 20px`
    - Live: `10px`
    - Fix: change to 10px in `.heading2` rule

11. **Feature-grid-how mobile margin-top** (`.featureGrid` in how-it-works.module.css):
    - Local at 375: `margin-top: 20px`
    - Live: `40px`
    - Fix: at @max-width:767 or 479 in `.featureGrid`, change margin-top to 40px

12. **Footer newsletter card background** (`.footer-newsletter-card` in footer.module.css):
    - Current: `background: transparent` (we set this for contrast)
    - Live: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)`
    - Visual issue: we removed the translucent white card. Restore it BUT fix contrast another way: child text colors stay readable on the dark navy section even with the translucent white overlay. Test contrast: white on rgba(255,255,255,0.3)+navy = effective ~rgb(155,160,180) = poor. Actually keep design: change inner text colors to navy `#082753` instead of white. Then bg restoration works.

13. **Paragraph color** (`.paragraph` in pain-points.module.css + built-for.module.css):
    - Local: `color: rgb(43, 43, 43)` = `#2b2b2b`
    - Live: `rgb(0, 0, 0)` = `#000`
    - Fix: change `.paragraph` color to `#000` in BOTH pain-points + built-for module CSS

14. **Ban-grid trust** (`.ban-grid.hom-ban-grd` in hero.module.css):
    - Local desktop: `margin-bottom: 50px`, mobile gap 17px, max-width 650px
    - Live desktop: `margin-bottom: 0`, mobile gap 12px, max-width 100%
    - Fix:
      - Base `.ban-grid.hom-ban-grd { margin-bottom: 0 }` (or 0 for the `.hom-ban-grd` modifier)
      - At @max-width:479, change gap to 12px and max-width to 100%

15. **Pricing CTA button height** (`.buttonPricing` in pricing-section.module.css):
    - Local: 46px, Live: 44px (2px off)
    - Fix: reduce padding by 1px top+bottom or reduce line-height slightly

16. **Newsletter badge border** — `.newsubott` or `.news-subhead-out`:
    - Local: `0px solid #e5e7eb`
    - Live: `0px none #333` (no border style)
    - Fix: change `border: 0px none` or just `border: none` in footer.module.css

17. **Save-pricing-badge padding** (`.pricingBadge` in pricing-section.module.css):
    - Local @375: `padding: 2px 8px`
    - Live: `2px 4px`
    - Fix: at @max-width:479 or 767, set `.pricingBadge { padding: 2px 4px }` (smaller horizontal)

18. **Trust-grid-box mobile padding** (`.grid-box.home-grid-box` in hero.module.css):
    - Local @375: `padding: 0px 10px`
    - Live: `13px 10px`
    - Fix: at @max-width:479, ensure `.home-grid-box { padding-top: 13px; padding-bottom: 13px }` survives (the order-mob-1/2/3 overrides may zero it)

19. **Feature-grid-benefits grid-template-columns** — local renders flex carousel (no grid), live uses CSS grid 1fr 1fr 1fr. Decision: Webflow uses Slick slider which renders as `display: block` slides — local's flex scroll-snap is closer functionally. Live shows grid because Slick is JS-disabled in the audit (Slick lazy-init). NOT a real bug. Skip.

20. **Feature-card-how mobile padding** (`.featureCardBlue` in how-it-works.module.css):
    - Local @375: `padding: 25px 18px 17px`
    - Live: `24px 18px` (top+bottom equal 24px)
    - Fix: at @max-width:479 in `.featureCardBlue`, set `padding: 24px 18px`

21. **Feature-grid-pain @1440 column gap** — live 418px cards, local 413px. Container max-width 1280 vs 1320 mismatch. Fix: at @min-width:1440 in pain-points.module.css, set `.container-large-3 { max-width: 1320px }` to match all other sections.

22. **Pricing-grid @1440** — same container issue. Fix: pricing-section.module.css `.containerLarge3` at @min-width:1440 → `max-width: 1320px`.

23. **Footer-link-column @768/375** — column widths off due to gap mismatch. Verify `.footer-links-grid` gap matches Webflow at all breakpoints.

24. **Btn-primary-nav mobile** — padding off (live `8px 8px`, local `8px 16px`), font-size 14.4px live vs 12.8 local. Fix mobile button padding/font.

25. **Btn-secondary-nav mobile** — padding `10px 20px` live vs `8px 20px` local; font-size 14 live vs 16 local. Fix.

WORKFLOW:
1. Read each affected file
2. Apply Webflow exact values (numbered above)
3. NO compensation hacks — revert any padding-bottom: 38px / padding-top: 26px style hacks. If revert breaks something else, use proper Webflow rules.
4. `pnpm build` 0 errors
5. Re-run spacing diff if time permits

CONSTRAINTS:
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- Don't break visual hierarchy
- Match Webflow values verbatim — no compensation
- Production-grade quality

OUTPUT: 1-line summary per fix # (1-25) + build result.
